tableLines.text: ◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
The Red Table's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.
Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Thornfield's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500
